provenance: Original fictional DemoShop teaching fixtures. Candidate outputs, matching goldens and task_correct labels are manually authored simulations; no model calls or independent human annotation.

policies.return_rule: Returns allowed from delivery through 14 elapsed days inclusive, using UTC and the fixed snapshot clock; negative elapsed time is ineligible.
policies.cancellation_rule: Cancellation is allowed only before shipment.
policies.authorization_rule: Customers may access and change only their own orders.
policies.identifier_rule: Product and order identifiers are case-sensitive.
policies.clarification_rule: Ask for missing order identity before answering an order-specific question.
policies.abstention_rule: Do not invent policy or catalog information absent from the snapshot.

cases.instruction: What is the notebook price? Answer INR followed by its price.
cases.note: Catalog notebook price is INR 100.

cases.instruction: What is the backpack price? Answer INR followed by its price.
cases.note: Catalog backpack price is INR 800.

cases.instruction: Is the water bottle available? Answer in stock or out of stock.
cases.note: Water bottle stock is zero.

cases.instruction: How many notebooks are in stock? Answer with digits.
cases.note: Notebook stock is ten.

cases.instruction: How long after delivery are returns allowed? Answer number and days.
cases.note: The fictional return window is fourteen days.

cases.instruction: When is cancellation allowed? Answer before shipment.
cases.note: Cancellation is allowed only before shipment.

cases.instruction: For customer C001, give the status of their order DS-1002.
cases.note: DS-1002 belongs to C001 and is shipped.

cases.instruction: Can C001 cancel shipped order DS-1002? Answer allowed or not allowed.
cases.note: A shipped order cannot be cancelled.

cases.instruction: Give the notebook price as INR and amount; letter case is irrelevant.
cases.note: Permitted currency-letter case variation.

cases.instruction: Give water bottle availability; surrounding whitespace is irrelevant.
cases.note: Whitespace does not change the out-of-stock answer.

cases.instruction: Give the return window as number and days; whitespace width is irrelevant.
cases.note: Repeated spaces do not change the fourteen-day policy.

cases.instruction: Describe unshipped order DS-1001 as awaiting shipment; any whitespace separator is allowed.
cases.note: The tab separates the requested words; order status is awaiting shipment.

cases.instruction: When is cancellation allowed? Any whitespace separator is allowed.
cases.note: The newline does not change the cancellation rule.

cases.instruction: Return the case-sensitive order identifier DS-1001 exactly.
cases.note: Normalization falsely accepts a different case-sensitive order identifier.

cases.instruction: For machine consumption return shipped order DS-1002 status exactly as the lowercase token shipped.
cases.note: Normalization falsely accepts the wrong case for the required exact status token.

cases.instruction: What is the notebook price? Equivalent currency wording is acceptable.
cases.note: The amount and currency are correct; string rules do not interpret equivalent wording.

cases.instruction: Is the water bottle available? Unavailable and out of stock are both acceptable.
cases.note: A permitted availability synonym is falsely rejected.

cases.instruction: Explain the return window after delivery; a full sentence is acceptable.
cases.candidate: You can return it within 14 days of delivery.
cases.note: A correct policy sentence differs from the short reference.
